blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs , and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs : staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller’s existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model’s loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
blocks.zh: 我们研究测试时间的演化 人机操纵: 解决一个控制者从未接受过训练的任务, 通过重新运用其现有的技能, 提高自己的尝试, 保留它所学的东西,而不进行再培训。 我们的主要见解是,一个广泛的控制者已经掌握着新任务需要的许多能力,而且这种能力通过规划和控制之间的接口而变得容易获得,这种接口足以说明接触丰富、多阶段的互动,但执行反馈可以执行和衡量,从而能够指导从经验出发的规划。 InterEvolve实现这个接口有两个组件. 首先,我们开发出一种有物体意识的前向后向(FB)行为基础模型,其物体残留在被冻结后的身体上,在测试时会先将关于身体或物体的新奖励转化为loco操纵行为. 第二,我们规定任务为奖励方案:按完成条件和可捕量进行奖励。 一个大型语言模型(LLM)代理在上下文中修改了程序结构,借鉴了执行反馈和已核实程序的技能库,而数字优化器则会调和其常数. 由于每个候选人都经过了平行模拟情景的验证,程序探索了新的诱导、重新使用和构成控制器现有机动能力的方法,从而改进了重复。 实验显示,人类设计的奖励使得FB模型的许多机电操纵能力得不到利用,而InterEvolve 方案则会释放这种能力,有时是通过新的策略。 它进一步为多种任务产生行为,复杂的场景,以及模拟中的长视距组成,并且从以自负为中心的机上感知,在物理Unitree G1上自主地演化出技能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Learned humanoid controllers now provide broad whole-body motion for real-robot control ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , as well as contact-rich loco-manipulation ( He et al., 2024 ) , trained from human data. Yet a humanoid in an open-ended environment will meet tasks and scenes that were not enumerated during training. Consider a controller that has learned to push, lift, and carry boxes from human demonstrations. When asked to tip a box onto another face, it does not have a demonstration of this behavior, although the motions it needs lie within what it can already do. We study test-time evolution , in which a humanoid finds such uses of its existing skills, improves from its own attempts within a budget of trials, and keeps what it learns, so that a later long-horizon composite task, such as carrying a box, placing it, and then kicking it, or a novel box tip, can build on earlier experience. What evolves is the task strategies, meaning which objectives to use or what stages to decompose, together with the experience retained across tasks, while the controller stays fixed.
blocks.zh: 已学会的人体活性控制器现在为实际机器人控制提供了广泛的全身运动(Luo等,2026年),以及从人类数据中培训的接触力丰富的loco操纵(He等,2024年). 然而,在无限制环境中的人造物将满足培训期间未列举的任务和场景。 考虑一个控制器, 已经学会了推,抬, 和携带箱子 从人类示威。 当被要求将一个盒子倒向另一个面孔时,它没有表现出这种行为,尽管它需要的运动就在于它已经能够做的. 我们研究测试时间进化,在这种进化中,人造人发现其现有技能的这种用途,在实验预算范围内通过自己的尝试改进,并保留它所学到的东西,这样,一个后来的长视距复合任务,如携带一个盒子,放入它,然后踢出它,或者一个新颖的盒子小费,可以借鉴早期的经验. 演进的是任务战略,意指使用什么目标或分解什么阶段,以及跨任务保留的经验,而控制者则固定不变.

blocks.en: Achieving this capability requires a way to state a new task that is expressive enough for contact-rich, multi-stage interaction, yet cheap to revise after each attempt. Common task interfaces for humanoid control, such as motion references ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , goal states ( He et al., 2026 ) , and skill labels ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , request desired motions, target states, or predefined behaviors. An objective such as tipping an object must therefore be translated into a reference goal or a new skill, either of which can be difficult to design for nuanced interactions. Rewards offer a more expressive alternative: they can specify contact-rich objectives and indicate where an attempt fell short, as their role in shaping such behavior during training demonstrates ( Andrychowicz et al., 2020 ) . Conventionally, however, each reward revision requires training a new policy, making it slow to iterate over many candidates ( Ma et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh: 实现这一能力需要一种方式来说明一项新任务,它足以表达接触丰富的多阶段互动,但在每次尝试后修改却很便宜. 人造相控的共同任务界面,如运动参考(Yang等,2025年),入球状态(He等,2026年)和技能标签(Wang等,2026年b),请求想要的运动,目标状态,或预先定义的行为. 因此,向对象倾斜等目标必须被转化为参考目标或新的技能,其中任何一个都难以设计出细微的相互作用. 奖励提供了一种更明确的选择:它们可以具体指明富于接触的目标,并指明尝试的不足之处,正如它们在培训期间塑造这种行为的作用所显示的那样(Andrychowicz等,2020年)。 但是,在常规方面,每次奖励修订都需要培训新的政策,使许多候选人的晋升速度缓慢(Ma等,2024a)。

blocks.en: We introduce InterEvolve , which builds this interface from reward programs and a behavioral foundation model that executes them without retraining (Fig. 1 ). A reward program is a sequence of stages, each with a reward and a completion condition, plus tunable weights and thresholds. To execute a program, we use a forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model ( Touati and Ollivier, 2021 ; Tirinzoni et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , which maps a reward to a latent that elicits the corresponding behavior from one fixed policy. Existing humanoid FB models, however, observe only the body, so rewards that differ only in the object’s goal can collapse into one behavior. We extend the model in two ways: we attach trainable object residuals that read object features to its frozen body networks, and we train these residuals on large-scale human-object interaction (HOI) data.
blocks.zh: 我们引入InterEvolve(InterEvolve),它从奖励方案以及不进行再培训的行为基础模型中构建了这一界面(图1)。 奖励方案是分阶段的顺序,每个阶段都有奖励和完成条件,加上可捕鲸重量和阈值。 为了执行一个程序,我们使用一个前向(FB)行为基础模型(Touati and Ollivier, 2021;Tirinzoni等, 2025;Li等, 2026),它将奖励描绘成从一个固定政策中引出相应行为的潜伏. 然而,现有的人造FB模型只观测到身体,因此只有物体目标不同的奖励才能崩溃成一种行为. 我们以两种方式扩展模型: 将读取物体特征的可训练物体残基附在其被冻结的体网上,我们将这些残基以大规模人与物体相互作用(HOI)数据来训练.

blocks.en: With execution in place, the central challenge becomes reward formulation itself. It is especially pronounced in loco-manipulation, where a naively handcrafted reward underperforms even if the controller contains the relevant motor capabilities. InterEvolve therefore lets a large language model (LLM) agent iterates reward programs in context : with its weights fixed, the agent combines task intent and execution feedback from simulation to refine the rewards and their composition. Instead of collecting references and training a policy for each new behavior, InterEvolve spends compute proposing, tuning, and verifying reward programs. This mirrors test-time scaling in language models, where more inference compute yields better solutions ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 随着执行的落实,中心挑战就变成了奖励的提法本身。 它在loco操纵中特别突出,一个天真地手工的奖励表现不佳,即使控制器包含相关的运动能力. 因此InterEvolve让一个大型语言模型(LLM)代理在上下文中执行奖励程序:由于它的权重固定了,代理将任务意图和执行反馈从模拟中结合起来来完善奖励及其组成. InterEvolve没有收集参考文献,也没有为每个新行为培训政策,而是花费计算提出、调整和核实奖励方案。 这反映了语言模型中的测试时间缩放,其中更多的推论计算得出更好的解决方案(Snell等人,2025;Brown等人,2024.).

blocks.en: We organize this evolution around two complementary objectives: improving the reward program for the current task and retaining what is learned to guide future tasks. ( i ) Two parts of a program must be searched together: its structure , meaning which rewards and stages it uses, and its constants , meaning the weights and thresholds. A promising structure can still fail under poor weights, so the agent revises the structure while an inner search with the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) ( Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001 ) tunes the constants of each proposal. Parallel simulation supplies batches of execution evidence, so each revision is guided by a comparison over many rollouts. ( ii ) For future tasks, InterEvolve summarizes successful reward programs as a skill library . Later tasks can retrieve these experiences without rediscovering them from scratch.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕两个相辅相成的目标来组织这一演变:改进当前任务的奖励方案并保留指导未来任务的知识。 (一. ) (中文(简体) ). 程序的两个部分必须一起搜索:它的结构,意思是它使用的奖励和阶段,它的常数,意思是权重和阈值. 在权重不佳的情况下,一个有希望的结构仍然可能失败,因此代理人修改了结构,而与共变矩阵适应演化战略(CMA-ES)(Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001)的内在搜索则会调和每个提案的常数. 平行模拟提供了批次的执行证据,因此每次修订都以比照许多推出为指南. (二) 国家 对于未来的任务,InterEvolve总结了成功的奖励程序作为技能库. 后期的任务可以收回这些经验而不会从零开始被重新发现.

blocks.en: Figure 1: InterEvolve adapts a frozen whole-body controller with novel use. The controller trained on human-object interaction (HOI), such as lifting and pushing a box, is asked to rotate a box around in place, a behavior absent from its training data (Sec. D.7 and Figure 11 ). A human-designed reward tries to hack this behavior but fails. The reward program that InterEvolve evolves compensate with novel body used to succeed. Bottom: InterEvolve can achieve versatile evolved skills in simulation and on a real robot. More demos are on the project page .
blocks.zh: 图1:InterEvolve以新颖的用法调整了被冷冻的全身控制器. 接受过人与物体相互作用(HOI)培训的控制器,如起起重和推出一个盒子,被要求在位置上旋转一个盒子,这个行为在其训练数据中没有出现(Sec.D.7和图11.). 人类设计的奖励试图黑客 这种行为但失败。 InterEvolve所演化的奖励程序以用来成功的小说体来补偿. 底部 : InterEvolve可以在模拟和真正的机器人上实现多功能的演化技能. 更多演示在项目页面上。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, a framework for self-evolving humanoid loco-manipulation that shifts task-specific compute from training to test-time evolution: an LLM agent learns in context to write and adapt reward programs that a fixed, reusable controller executes for new tasks and scenes. Second, an object-aware FB behavioral foundation model that translates reward objectives into whole-body interaction. Third, an evaluation of how reward design and accumulated experience affect reference tracking and goal-conditioned tasks, showing that success grows with evolution. We further show unseen tasks and long-horizon compositions in simulation and fully autonomous deployment on a physical Unitree G1 from onboard perception.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 首先,一个自我演化的人类自相机操控的框架,将任务特定计算从训练转向测试时间演化:一个LLM代理学习在上下文中写出并调整奖励程序,一个固定的,可再使用的控制器执行新的任务和场景. 其次,一个有对象意识的FB行为基础模型,将奖励目标转化为全身互动. 第三,评价奖励设计和积累的经验如何影响参考跟踪和目标设定的任务,表明成功随着演变而增加。 我们进一步显示在模拟和完全自主地从机上感知到的物理Unitree G1上的任务和长视距构成。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Humanoid loco-manipulation and task interfaces. Humanoid control has grown reusable, from simulated characters ( Peng et al., 2018 ; Peng et al., 2022 ) to real-robot whole-body policies learned from teleoperation and human motion ( Fu et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Ze et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Loco-manipulation policies learn grasping and contact-rich interaction from references ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Tessler et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2026b ) and transfer to real robots ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ) . Others condition control on multimodal prompts ( Kareer et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Kalaria et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , sequences existing skills with planners ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Tevet et al., 2025 ) , or imitates video-imagined interactions ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . InterEvolve instead states the task as a reward program, which says which contacts and stage transitions matter, and revises it after each attempt.
blocks.zh: 人机操纵和任务界面. 从模拟人物(Peng等人,2018年;Peng等人,2022年)到从远程操作和人类运动中吸取的真机器人全体政策(Fu等人,2024年;He等人,2024年;Ji等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年;Yin等人,2026年;Liao等人,2026年;Ze等人,2025年;Luo等人,2026年),人体控制已经变得可以再用. Loco-manifulation政策从参考文献(Luo等,2024;Xu等,2025;Tessler等,2025;Wang等,2025b;Xu等,2026b)中学习把握力和接触力丰富的相互作用,并转让给真正的机器人(Liu等,2025;Li等,2024;Sun等,2025;Yang等,2025;赵等,2025;Fu等,2026;Wang等,2025a;He等,2026). 另一些则对多式联运催化剂实行控制(Kareer等人,2025年;Xue等人,2025年;Ding等人,2025年;Deng等人,2026年;Kalaria等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年;Xie等人,2026年),与规划者对现有技能进行排序(Yuan等人,2025年;Wen等人,2025年;Ren等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Xia等人,2024年;Tevet等人,2025年),或模仿视频想象的互动。 (陈等,2026). InterEvolve 转而将任务说成是一种奖励程序,它说哪些接触和阶段过渡很重要,并在每次尝试后修改.

blocks.en: Behavioral foundation models and reward inference. Successor features decouple occupancy from reward ( Dayan, 1993 ; Barreto et al., 2017 ) , and FB representations factorize the successor measure so a backward map projects any reward into a latent prompt ( Touati and Ollivier, 2021 ; Touati et al., 2023 ) . Humanoid behavioral foundation models thus run one policy for new rewards, goals, or references without task-specific training ( Tirinzoni et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Follow-ups refines the representation ( Cetin et al., 2025 ; Bagatella et al., 2026 ) , searches the latent space ( Sikchi et al., 2025b ) , infers tasks online ( Rupf et al., 2025 ; Bagot et al., 2026 ) , grounds language ( Sikchi et al., 2025a ) . These models observe only the body, so rewards that differ only in what happens to an object collapse into one behavior. Our object-aware FB model removes this limit.
blocks.zh: 行为基础模型和奖励推论. 继任者将占用与奖励脱钩(Dayan,1993年;Barreto等,2017年),而FB的表述将后续措施考虑在内,因此,一个后向地图将任何奖励推向潜在的奖励(Touati和Ollivier,2021年;Touati等,2023年)。 因此,人类行为基础模型实行一项政策,对没有具体任务培训的新奖励、目标或参考(Tirinzoni等,2025;Li等,2026)。 后续行动完善了表述方式(Cetin等人,2025年;Bagatella等人,2026年),搜索潜在空间(Sikchi等人,2025年b),推断在线任务(Rupf等人,2025年;Bagot等人,2026年),理由语言(Sikchi等人,2025年a年)。 这些模型只观测到身体,所以奖励只有在物体崩溃成一个行为时才会有所不同. 我们的有物体意识的FB模型取消了这个限制.

blocks.en: Reward design and agents that learn from execution. Language models write reward functions from task descriptions ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , refine them from simulator feedback ( Ma et al., 2024a ; Ma et al., 2024b ) , and search over reward designs ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , including for humanoid locomotion ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , but each candidate reward is realized by training a policy. Language to Rewards optimizes LLM-written rewards with model predictive control instead ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . MotionDisco evolves humanoid motions with an LLM and trajectory optimization before training trackers for them ( Taouil et al., 2026 ) , and ROSETTA builds multi-stage reward programs from language preferences ( Srivastava et al., 2026 ) . Coding agents likewise refine executable plans from feedback and retain reusable experience ( Liang et al., 2023 ; Zha et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Elmaaroufi et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . In InterEvolve, each candidate reward costs a batch of rollouts on a fixed controller rather than an RL run, and verified programs form a skill library for later tasks.
blocks.zh: 奖励从执行中学习的设计和代理人. 语言模型从任务描述(谢等,2024年)中写出奖励功能,从模拟反馈(马等,2024年a;马等,2024年b)中细化,并搜索奖励设计(张等,2025年;高等等,2025年;李等,2026年),包括人体运动(吴等,2025年),但每个考生的奖励通过培训政策来实现. " 奖励语言 " 用模型预测控制优化LLM书面奖励(Yu等,2023;Liang等,2024)。 MotionDisco用LLM和轨迹优化来演化人形运动,然后为其培训跟踪器(Taouil等,2026年),ROSETTA从语言偏好建立多阶段奖励程序(Srivastava等,2026年). 编码剂同样通过反馈完善可执行计划并保留可再使用的经验(梁等,2023;张等,2024;周等,2024;吕等,2026;埃尔马阿鲁菲等,2026;萧等,2026;王等,2026a.). 在InterEvolve中,每个候选人的奖励花费在固定控制器而不是RL运行上的一批推出,经过核实的程序构成了后期任务的技能库.

blocks.en: Test-time compute and search. Language models improve with more inference compute through repeated sampling, step-level search, and long reasoning ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Brown et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , and program-search systems evolve code against an automatic evaluator ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) . In control, test-time search usually plans actions with a dynamics model ( Hansen et al., 2024 ) or steers a pretrained humanoid policy ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . InterEvolve searches over task specifications instead, keeping the controller fixed and verifying proposed reward programs in parallel rollouts.
blocks.zh: 测试时间计算与搜索. 语言模型通过反复取样、分级搜索和长推理进行更多的推论计算而改进(Snell等,2025;Brown等,2024;Guo等,2025;以及程序搜索系统对照自动评估员演化出代码(Romera-Paredes等,2024;Novikov等,2025)。 在控制上,测试时间搜索通常计划有动态模型的行动(Hansen等,2024年)或指导预先训练的人形政策(张等,2026年;徐等,2026年;曹等,2026年). 间 转而对任务规格进行搜索,使控制器固定下来,并在平行推出时核查提议的奖励程序。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: InterEvolve overview. (a) Given a task and scene, an LLM agent writes a staged reward program, drawing on verified programs in the skill library. (b) The forward-backward model scores the active stage’s reward over a fixed state bank and projects it into a latent prompt, which a frozen body prior and a pretrained object residual execute without retraining. (c) A fixed verifier scores parallel rollouts, and criterion-level feedback drives the next structural revision (outer loop), while CMA-ES tunes the program constants (inner loop).
blocks.zh: 图2:演变间概览。 (a) 鉴于任务和场景,一个LLM代理员根据技能库中经过核实的程序撰写一个有舞台的奖励程序。 (b) 后退模式将活跃阶段的奖励评为固定国家银行的奖励,并把它投放潜在的提示器中,一个被冻结的身体在未经再培训的情况下先行执行,一个经过预先训练的物体剩余部分则不进行再培训。 (c) 固定核查员的分数平行推出,标准级反馈驱动下个结构修订(出环),而CMA-ES调用程序常数(内环).

blocks.en: InterEvolve adapts a fixed whole-body controller to new loco-manipulation tasks by evolving a reward programs at test time, and keeps verified programs in a skill library for later tasks to build on (Fig. 2 ). Sec. 3.1 formalizes this evolving problem and its budget. Sec. 3.2 defines reward programs, the editable task strategies that the evolve operates on. Sec. 3.3 shows how an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model executes a reward program without retraining. Sec. 3.4 presents the evolution: an LLM agent revises program structure, CMA-ES ( Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001 ) calibrates program constants, and the skill library carries verified programs to later tasks.

blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
A task is a language request ℓ \ell and a scene context c c , such as object poses and obstacles. In Figure 2 , ℓ \ell asks the robot to kick a box to a mark with its feet only. A fixed pretrained controller π ⁡ ( 𝒂 t ∣ 𝒐 t , 𝒛 ) \pi(\boldsymbol{a}_{t}\mid\boldsymbol{o}_{t},\boldsymbol{z}) maps policy observation 𝒐 t \boldsymbol{o}_{t} and latent prompt 𝒛 \boldsymbol{z} to action 𝒂 t \boldsymbol{a}_{t} . The agent links them through a reward program P P of staged rewards (Sec. 3.2 ), whose active-stage reward becomes 𝒛 \boldsymbol{z} (Sec. 3.3 ). Executing P P from a scenario, a randomized initial condition, yields a trajectory τ = ( 𝒔 0 , 𝒂 0 , … , 𝒔 T ) \tau=(\boldsymbol{s}_{0},\boldsymbol{a}_{0},\ldots,\boldsymbol{s}_{T}) over the privileged body-object state 𝒔 t \boldsymbol{s}_{t} that rewards and the verifier read.
Success is judged by a verifier 𝒞 = { C i } i = 1 N C \mathcal{C}=\{C_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N_{C}} whose criteria C i ​ ( τ ) C_{i}(\tau) check task outcomes and physical constraints, such as staying upright and keeping the hands off the box (Figure 2 c). For language-specified tasks, an LLM-assisted parser instantiates 𝒞 \mathcal{C} from ℓ \ell and c c once, and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} then stays fixed, so the agent cannot ease a task by rewriting its evaluator. A request thus goes through ( ℓ , c ) → P → 𝒛 → τ → 𝒞 ⁡ ( τ ) (\ell,c)\to P\to\boldsymbol{z}\to\tau\to\mathcal{C}(\tau) , and we cast adaptation as a evolution over P P alone: within a budget of K K rounds, find a program whose trajectories satisfy better criterion in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . The evolution keeps a current best program , the strongest one 𝒞 \mathcal{C} has confirmed so far, and each round tries to replace it (Sec. 3.4 ).
Across tasks, a skill library ℋ \mathcal{H} stores each task’s final program and verifier results, so the agent can start a new task from earlier solutions, such as the push, lift, and carry programs in Figure 2 a.

blocks.en: 3.2 Reward programs as editable task strategies
blocks.zh: 3.2 奖励程序作为可编辑的任务战略

blocks.en: The evolution needs a strategy representation that can specify multi-stage, contact-rich interaction and can be edited in response to execution evidence. A reward program P = ( 𝜽 , { ( r j , g j ) } j = 1 J ) P=\big(\boldsymbol{\theta},\{(r_{j},g_{j})\}_{j=1}^{J}\big) consists of an ordered list of J J stages and a vector of tunable constants 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} . Each stage j j is one phase of interaction, such as orienting toward an object, acquiring contact, transporting, or releasing. As shown in Figure 2 , it holds reward code r j r_{j} , which scores body-object states through declared features, and a completion condition g j g_{j} , which reads live rollout context such as object pose, contact status, and stage time and returns whether the stage is complete. Execution stays in stage j j until g j g_{j} holds and then advances to stage j + 1 j+1 , and the last stage runs until the episode ends. The constants 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} are the numbers that r j r_{j} and g j g_{j} read, such as weights, tolerances, kernel widths, and stage thresholds.

blocks.en: This representation gives the agent explicit handles for evolution: what each stage rewards ( r j r_{j} ), when execution moves to the next stage ( g j g_{j} ), and the weights and thresholds that calibrate both ( 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} ). The controller, in turn, realizes each stage with the motor behaviors learned in pretraining. To switch from lifting an object to sliding it, for example, the agent edits the object-motion rewards and stage conditions instead of specifying a new joint trajectory. The representation also separates the structure of a program, namely its stages, reward terms, and completion conditions, from its constants 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} , so the agent revises the structure while a numerical optimizer tunes 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} (Sec. 3.4 ).

blocks.en: Object-aware interaction representation. The pretrained FB model of BFM-Zero ( Li et al., 2026 ) observes only the body. Rewards that differ only in where the object should go can therefore collapse into the same behavior. We give all three of its networks, the actor and the forward and backward maps, access to the object, while each keeps its pretrained body branch frozen (Fig. 2 b). The actor keeps the local body observations of BFM-Zero and adds heading-frame object features: object position, orientation, linear and angular velocity, and distance-decayed vectors from body links to the nearest object surface ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . The forward and backward maps are extended in the same way, each adding a trainable object residual to a frozen body branch. blocks.en: 3.4 Evolving reward programs at test time
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 测试时正在演变奖励程序

blocks.en: InterEvolve evolves over programs with two nested loops (Algorithm 1 ), because program structure and constants call for different searchers. An LLM agent is well suited to choosing a program’s reward terms and stages, whereas a numerical optimizer is better at finding the constants that make a given structure work. The outer loop therefore lets the agent revise program structure, and the inner loop tunes 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} with CMA-ES ( Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001 ) . Both loops evaluate each candidate on a set of scenarios in parallel, so every decision rests on many rollouts.
blocks.zh: InterEvolve通过两个嵌入式循环(Algorithm 1 )的程序进行进化,因为程序结构和常数需要不同的搜索者. LLM 代理非常适合选择程序的奖励条件和阶段,而数字优化器则更适合找到使特定结构发挥作用的常数. 因此外环让代理修改程序结构,内环调用 CMA-ES (Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001.). 这两个循环对每个候选人进行平行的一套设想方案的评价,因此每个决定都取决于许多推出方案。

blocks.en: Outer loop: structural revision. Each round starts with one prompt to the agent (Sec. C.2 ). The prompt contains the task request, scene context, and verifier 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , the current best program with its rollout feedback, and the skill library ℋ \mathcal{H} . The agent learns only from this context, as its weights stay fixed. It proposes several new programs. A validator discards programs that break the code rules, such as reading an undeclared feature, before any rollout. Keeping the current best in context encourages targeted repairs when a strategy is close, while allowing new structures when it is not.
blocks.zh: 外环:结构修订. 每发一发从一发催取剂(Sec. C.2.)起. 提示包含任务请求, 场景上下文, 以及验证器 C\ mathcal{C} , 及其推出反馈的当前最佳程序, 以及技能库 H\ mathcal{H} 。 代理人只从这个上下文中学习,因为它的分量保持不变. 它提出了几个新的方案。 验证器在任何推出前都会丢弃违反代码规则的程序,例如读取未宣布的特性. 保持目前的最佳环境,鼓励在战略接近时进行有针对性的维修,同时允许在不接近时进行新的建筑。

blocks.en: Inner loop: numerical calibration. The same structure can fail under poor relative weighting, so each valid proposal is calibrated before judging. The inner loop freezes a program’s stages and reward terms and evolves only over 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} ( e.g. strike weight θ 0 \theta_{0} and the stage threshold θ 4 \theta_{4} in Figure 2 a), within agent-declared bounds. CMA-ES samples constants, the simulator evaluates each on the evolution scenarios in parallel, and the sampling distribution moves toward better-scoring constants.
blocks.zh: 内环:数值校正. 同一结构在相对权重差的情况下会失败,因此每个有效提案在判断前都会被校正. 内环冻结一个程序的阶段和奖励条件,并且只在\\boldsymbol\theta}(例如:打击重量 \ 0\theta\0}和在图2a中的舞台门槛 \ 4\theta\4}) 内,在代理宣布的界限内演变。 CMA-ES样本常数,模拟器以平行的方式对每个演化场景进行评估,样本分布向分数更高的常数移动.

blocks.en: Selection and feedback. Tuned candidates are compared with the current best program on the same evolution scenarios, so outcome differences reflect the programs rather than their initial conditions. The strongest candidate is then re-evaluated together with the current best, three times each. It replaces the current best only if its improvement under 𝒞 \mathcal{C} exceeds the run-to-run evaluation noise. An accepted edit is one whose gain carries over to new initial conditions. The next prompt reports these outcomes per criterion and per stage. For round 1 of the kick task (Figure 2 c), it reports that the hand criterion still fails in a minority of environments although the median environment passes it, and how each program leads to failure. Such reports locate the stage to repair, and learn from success, as well as failures and their reasons behind (Sec. C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 遴选与反馈. 受培训的考生在相同的演化场景中被与目前的最佳方案作比较,因此结果差异反映了方案而不是其初始条件. 然后,对最强的候选人与目前最好的候选人一起进行重新评价,每人3次。 它只有在C \ mathcal{C} 的改进超过运行中的评价噪声时才能取代当前最好的. 被接受的编辑是其收益延续到新的初始条件. 下次及时报告每个标准和每个阶段的这些结果。 对于踢球任务第1轮(图2 c),它报告说,虽然中位环境通过,但手标准在少数环境中仍然失败,每个程序如何导致失败. 这些报告确定了修复的舞台,并从成功中吸取教训,以及失败及其背后的原因(第C.2节)。

blocks.en: Budget and termination. The budget K K counts revision rounds after the initial program. Each round makes one agent call and spends 192 tuning rollouts on every valid proposal plus 192 rollouts to confirm the top candidate, so its cost is bounded, and simulation dominates it (Sec. C.4 ). Evolution stops once the K K rounds are spent, or earlier if the current best program satisfies every criterion in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} on the confirmation scenarios. It returns the current best program, which is then added to ℋ \mathcal{H} .
blocks.zh: 预算和终止。 预算 K K 计算了初始方案之后的修订回合。 每轮进行一通代理通话,花费192个调试推出每个有效提案外加192个推出确认顶级候选人,因此其成本是受限的,模拟主导(Sec.C.4. K 回合用完后, 或当当前最佳程序满足 C\ mathcal{C} 中确认方案的所有标准时, 进化停止 。 它返回当前最佳程序,然后添加到 H\ mathcal{H} 。

blocks.en: Skill library. The skill library is a text document for summarizing tasks, placed in the agent’s prompt every round. Each entry records a completed task: its scene, task text, verifier with the pass rate of each criterion, and the selected program with its tuned constants. With these entries in context, the agent can compose or adapt established programs instead of evolving from scratch.
blocks.zh: 技能图书馆. 技能库是用于总结任务的文本文档, 放在代理商的提示中 。 每个条目记录一个已完成的任务:它的场景,任务文本,每个标准通过率的验证符,以及被选中的有调制常数的程序. 在这些条目的上下文中,代理可以编程或调整已建立的程序,而不是从零开始演化.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: This section verifies that our low-level controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that test-time scaling over reward programs makes it accessible, through three questions. ( i ) Competence: can object-aware motor model provide reusable whole-body interaction, and does better reward improve tracking (Sec. 4.2 )? ( ii ) Access: without reference motion, does execution-guided evolution reach behaviors fixed programs miss, and which evolution components produce the gain (Sec. 4.3 )? ( iii ) Accumulation: does a skill library solve composite tasks whose contact modes it covers, and do selected programs transfer to new conditions and hardware (Sec. 4.4 )?
blocks.zh: 本节核实我们的低级控制器已经掌握了新的任务需要的大部分能力,通过三个问题,测试时间比奖励程序更可访问。 (一. ) (中文(简体) ). 能力:能使物体意识运动模型提供可再利用的全体相互作用,并且能更好地奖励改进的跟踪(第4.2条)吗? (二) 国家 访问:没有引用运动,执行引导进化是否达到行为固定程序丢失,哪些进化组件产生收益(Sec 4. 3)? (三) 积累:一个技能库是否解决它所覆盖的接触模式的复合任务,选择的程序是否转移到新的条件和硬件(Sec 4.4)?

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Data and embodiment. We pretrain the separated FB models on human-object interaction from OMOMO ( Li et al., 2023 ) and GRAB ( Taheri et al., 2020 ) . OMOMO covers whole-body manipulation of large objects such as boxes and tables, GRAB whole-body grasping of small objects. We retarget both to the Unitree G1 ( Unitree Robotics, ) with rubber hands and to the G1 with Inspire hands ( Inspire Robots, ) , adapting OmniRetarget ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to the dexterous hands. Following ULTRA ( He et al., 2026 ) , we use the four box-like OMOMO objects: large box, plastic box, small box, and suitcase. For each object we hold out 50 clips for evaluation and train on the remaining 3,866; the held-out large-box clips form the tracking benchmark. The Inspire-hand G1 with GRAB shows qualitatively that InterEvolve extends to dexterous whole-body manipulation. DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026a ) writes the reward programs. All controllers run in Isaac Lab ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) , the transfer study replays selected programs on the real G1. For general-purpose tasks, we create a dedicated evaluation benchmark (Sec. D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 数据与出自相. 我们从OMOMO(Li等,2023年)和GRAB(Taheri等,2020年)对分离的FB模型进行人与物体相互作用的培训。 OMOMO覆盖了大物体的全体操纵,如箱和表,GRAB全体抓住小物体等. 我们用橡胶手重新瞄准Unitree G1(Unitree Robotics, )和用Inspire手(Inspire Robots, )重新瞄准G1, 使OmniReoctar(Yang等, 2025年)适应自相矛盾的手. 在ULTRA(He等,2026年)之后,我们使用四个盒子般的OMOMO物体:大盒子,塑料盒,小盒子和手提箱. 对于每个物体,我们持有50个片段,用于对剩余的3 866个物体进行评估和培训;被搁置的大盒片段构成跟踪基准。 带有GRAB的Inspirte-hand G1在质量上显示"InterEvolve"延伸至可分解的全身操纵. DeepSeek-V4-Flash(徐等,2026a)写出奖励方案. 所有控制器运行于艾萨克实验室(Mittal等,2025年),转移研究在真实的G1上重放所选程序. 就一般用途任务而言,我们制定专门的评价基准(Sec.D.3)。

blocks.en: Metrics. For tracking, E h E_{h} and E o E_{o} are the mean body-joint and object-surface errors against the reference in cm, and the success rate ( SR ) is the fraction of clips tracked to the end without a fall, an object deviation above 0.5 m, or a lost required contact ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . For general-purpose tasks, SR requires every task criterion and physical constraint to hold in the same rollout, while earned tiers ( Earned ) measure the mean fraction of criteria passed. Standing still already passes about half of the criteria (Table 2 ), so SR is the more representative primary metric. Every reported metric is averaged over three independent evaluation runs. We report evolving cost as single-GPU wall time (GPU-h) and total LLM tokens (prompt + output, millions) for one complete evolution on one task family. Fixed external criteria score each general-purpose task; details are in Sec. D .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 就跟踪而言,Eh E_{h}和Eo E_{o}是相对于引用的cm中的平均机身和物体表面错误,成功率(SR)是跟踪到尾部的片段没有掉落,物体偏差超过0.5米,或失去必要的接触(徐等,2025年). 就一般用途任务而言,斯洛伐克共和国要求每个任务标准和物理约束都在同一阶段展开,而挣得的等级(Earned)则衡量所通过标准的平均比例。 站着已经超过标准的一半(表2), 每个报告衡量标准平均在三次独立评价中进行。 我们把不断演变的成本作为单-GPU壁时间(GPU-h)和LLM符号(即时+输出,以百万计)报告在一个任务家族上一个完整的演化. 固定外部标准对每项一般用途任务评分;详情见Sec.D.。

blocks.en: Baselines. For tracking, we adapt the tracking policy of ULTRA ( He et al., 2026 ) , a generalist trained with motion imitation to follow loco-manipulation references, which we train on the same data as our motor model, and with BFM-Zero ( Li et al., 2026 ) , a pretrained body-only FB model. For general-purpose tasks, no public method applies directly to our setting under complex scene context, so we compare InterEvolve with several variations on the same controller: a human-written program and the agent’s initial program, each executed directly or after CMA-ES calibration.
blocks.zh: 基线。 为了跟踪,我们调整了ULTRA(He等,2026年)的跟踪政策,他是一个接受运动仿真训练的通论家,遵循loco-manapulation参考文献,我们用和我们的运动模型相同的数据来训练,他和BFM-Zero(Li等,2026年)是一个事先训练过的仅是身体的FB模型. 对于通用任务,没有公用方法直接适用于我们在复杂场景背景下的设置,所以我们比较InterEvolve和同一控制器上的几个变体:一个人写的程序和代理的初始程序,每个程序直接执行或者在CMA-ES校正后执行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Reusable control for reference tracking
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 可重复使用的参考跟踪控制

blocks.en: Object-aware FB can match a dedicated tracker. Table 2 tests whether one controller can mimic body motion and object interaction. ULTRA, an RL tracker trained for tracking alone, has the lowest errors. Our motor model, which also serves reward programs, approaches its success rate, whereas the body-only BFM-Zero loses the object on most clips, so object-aware pretraining supplies the interaction competence that reward programs repurpose. Without the link-to-surface vectors or the object state, the controller still follows the body but rarely succeeds (Table 6 ), and the same network trained from scratch almost never works, whereas residuals on the frozen body prior improve with width (Table 7 ), so the prior carries body skills and the residual learns interaction.
blocks.zh: 具有对象意识的FB可以匹配专用跟踪器. 表2测试一个控制器是否能够模仿身体运动和物体相互作用. ULTRA是接受过单独跟踪训练的RL跟踪器,其出错最少. 我们的马达模型也服务于奖励程序,它接近成功率,而只有身体的BFM-Zero在大多数剪辑上失去对象,因此物体意识预训提供了奖励程序重新用途的交互能力. 如果没有连接到地表的向量或物体状态,控制器仍然跟随身体,但很少成功(表6),从头开始训练的同一种网络几乎从不起作用,而被冷冻后身体上所残留的去向则会随着宽度而提高(表7),所以前所携带的体能和所剩余去学习相互作用.

blocks.en: Evolving rewards unlock the potential for motion tracking. Reward design matters even in tracking. Our actor observes the body and object in a local frame, so world-frame drift from the reference is invisible to it. The agent finds a reward that supplies this signal: an object-anchored drift correction blended with the reference prompt (Sec. B.2 ). It reduces both errors, lifts success above ULTRA, and nearly halves the final drift of root and object (Figure 5 ). The same procedure also tracks dexterous whole-body manipulation of small objects with Inspire hands (Figure 3 (a)).
blocks.zh: 不断演变的奖励 释放出追踪运动的潜力 奖励设计即使在追踪中都很重要. 我们的演员在局部范围内观察身体和物体,所以世界范围从参考物上漂移是看不见的. 特工找到一个能提供这个信号的奖赏:一个物体-受干扰的漂移修正与参考快取(Sec. B.2.)相混合. 它能减少两个出错,将成功提升到ULTRA之上,使根和物体的最终漂移量几乎减半(图5). 同一程序还跟踪用Inspire手对小物体进行全能操纵(图3(a))。

D.3 ): pushing to a mark, carrying at several heights, tipping or reorienting an object, feet-only interaction, lifting onto a support, and pushing through gates or around obstacles. Success depends on contact mode, obstacle layout, and when to switch phases. Each run starts from the task text and the observed scene, and only the reward program changes.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来删除参考动议,只具体说明任务结果和制约因素。 基准跨出8个任务家族(Sec.D.3):向一个标记推进,在几个高地上携带,向一个物体倾斜或调整方向,只用脚进行交互,向一个支撑上起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起 成功取决于接触模式,障碍布局,以及何时切换相. 每次跑从任务文本和被观测到的场景开始,只有奖励程序会改变.

blocks.en: Formulation, not hyperparameters, limits a written reward. Table 2 separates three effects. A reward written once is not enough: even the agent’s initial program, which outperforms the human-designed one, fails in most episodes. CMA-ES calibration of the weights alone brings limited gains, since better weights cannot repair an objective with the wrong structure. InterEvolve more than doubles the success of the best calibrated program, and because both fixed programs are calibrated, this gap comes from structural changes: what is rewarded and how objectives are staged.
blocks.zh: 配制,而非超参数,限制书面奖励. 表2分别了三种效果. 一次写出的奖励是不够的:甚至代理商的初始程序(它比人类设计的程序要好)在大多数情况下都失败了。 光是CMA-ES校正重量就只能带来有限的增益,因为更好的重量无法用错误的结构修复一个目标. InterEvolve 将最佳校正程序的成功率翻了一番以上,并且由于两个固定程序都是校正的,这个差距来自于结构变化:奖励什么和如何设定目标.

blocks.en: Evolution helps most where fixed programs fail. Calibrated fixed programs solve pushing to a mark but succeed in at most a quarter of the episodes when carrying at chest height, tipping onto a new face, or pushing through a gate or around an obstacle (Table 13 ). Evolution lifts each of these families above 70% success. Kicking to a mark remains the hardest, since kicks are rare in the training data and need strong whole-body coordination from the reward.
blocks.zh: 进化在固定程序失败时帮助最多. 校准的固定程序解决了推向标记的问题,但在胸高、向新面孔倾斜、或从大门或障碍物周围推入时最多成功四分之一(表13)。 进化使每个家庭的成功率超过70%。 踢入一分仍然是最难的,因为踢入在训练数据中是罕见的,需要从奖励中进行强有力的全身协调.

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of the search design. Stages and numerical calibration are most important designs. Each row disables one component (✗) of the full system; definitions are in Sec. D.5 .
blocks.zh: 表3:搜索设计的差异. 相相相和数值校正是最重要的设计. 每行禁用整个系统的一个组件(QQ);定义在Sec.D.5.中。

blocks.en: Staging and calibration matter most. Every evolution component contributes (Table 3 ; Sec. D.5 defines each variant). Forcing a single stage causes the largest drop, so contact-rich interaction needs a task decomposed into phases with their own objectives. Removing numerical tuning is nearly as harmful, since a program can only be judged once its constants are calibrated. Dropping targeted edits, so that the agent rewrites each program from scratch, or multi-scenario evaluation, so that each candidate runs from a single start, costs a similar amount: repairing a working program is more reliable than regenerating it, and varied starts tell a robust edit from a lucky one. Scene context, which describes obstacles and supports, has the smallest effect but still helps.
blocks.zh: 粘接和校正是最重要的。 每个演化部分都有所贡献(表3;Sec.D.5定义了每个变体). 强制单相导致最大下降,因此富于接触的互动需要一个任务分解成具有自己目标的阶段. 删除数调几乎同样有害,因为一个程序只有在它的常数被校正后才能判断出. 丢弃目标编辑,这样代理从零开始重写每个程序,或者进行多情景评价,使每个候选人从一个开始运行,费用相近:修复一个工作程序比再生成它更可靠,并且从一个幸运的开始显示一个强大的编辑. 描述障碍和支持的场景背景效果最小,但仍有帮助.

blocks.en: Success grows with test-time scaling, though not monotonically. Table 5 tracks the current best program over rounds, with the controller weights fixed. The first round brings most of the gain by removing the initial program’s coarse failures, and later rounds resolve the remaining criteria. Earned tiers rise monotonically, whereas full success dips from round 2 to round 3, since it requires all criteria in the same rollout and fixing one criterion can briefly break another. Tokens grow linearly with rounds, but simulation dominates the cost, with minutes per round in the language model against tens of minutes of rollouts (Sec. C.4 ), so a faster simulator such as mjlab ( Zakka et al., 2026 ) in place of Isaac Lab ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) could shorten evolution substantially. Figure 7 shows that revised rewards change the contact strategy itself.
blocks.zh: 成功随着试验时间的扩大而增加,尽管不是单调的。 表5按回合跟踪当前最佳程序,并固定控制器重量。 第一轮通过去除最初程序粗糙的失败而带来大部分收益,后一轮解决了所余标准. 收入水平单调上升,而从第2轮到第3轮完全成功下降,因为它要求在同一展开中制定所有标准,并且确定一个标准可以短暂地打破另一个标准。 托肯斯会随着轮回而线性地增长,但模拟却主导了成本,语言模型中每轮分数分数与数十分的滚出相比(Sec. C. 4.),因此更快的模拟器如mjlab(Zakka等,2026年)来取而代之的艾萨克实验室(Mittal等,2025年)可以大大地缩短进化. 图7显示,经修订的奖励办法改变了联系战略本身。

blocks.en: Qualitative results and real deployment from onboard perception. Figures 8 , 9 , and 10 show goal-conditioned skills evolved in simulation, in which acquisition, transport, placement, and handling arise from reward programs run by the shared controller. Figure 4 deploys programs evolved for two tasks on a physical Unitree G1. The robot detects the box with its egocentric camera, and FoundationPose ( Wen et al., 2024 ) estimates its 6-D pose, which supplies the controller’s object features. Each program is evolved and verified in simulation, then run on the robot.

blocks.en: 4.4 Reuse and composition
blocks.zh: 4.4 重复使用和组成

blocks.en: Composite tasks need a library that covers their contact modes. Evolved experience is valuable only if later tasks can reuse it. Table 5 evaluates three composite tasks that each combine previously evolved objectives in one episode: relocating an object between supports, stacking one box on another, and carrying, placing, then kicking an object. We compare the full skill library with no library and a carry-only library. With the full library, the agent solves most relocation episodes and about half of the stacking and carry-place-kick episodes, but almost none without a library. The carry-only library recovers most of relocation but helps little on stacking or kicking. Reuse therefore depends on covering the contact modes a task needs, not on having any stored experience.
blocks.zh: 复合任务需要一个包含其接触模式的库. 只有当以后的任务能够重复使用时,不断发展的经验才有价值。 表5评价了三个复合任务,每个任务在一个集中结合了以前发展出的目标:将一个对象移到支持之间,将一个盒子堆放在另一个盒子上,并携带,放置,再踢出一个对象. 我们把全技能图书馆与没有图书馆和只载式图书馆进行比较。 有了完整的图书库,代理解决了大多数的迁移相片和大约一半的堆放和背负-kick相片,但几乎没有一个没有图书库. 仅载运的图书馆可以恢复大部分的搬迁,但很少有助于堆放或踢。 因此,重新使用取决于是否涵盖任务需要的接触模式,而不是是否拥有任何存储的经验。

blocks.en: Evolving adapts stored programs. A finer ablation on carry, place, and kick shows that stored programs run without evolution almost never solve the task (Table 16 ), so the gain comes from evolution integrating skill library rather than from direct retrieval. Broader coverage still helps.

The same agent for evolution orders the boxes, and each leg runs a walking program to the box followed by the evolved pushing program. One controller executes all twelve phases from a single reset, so errors accumulate across legs instead of being reset away. In the take shown, all six boxes end within 11 cm of their cells and no placed box is disturbed by later legs. More are on project page .

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: InterEvolve suggests a different division of labor for humanoid intelligence. A behavioral foundation model learns how to move once, and task knowledge lives outside its weights, in reward programs that a language model can read, edit, and test by execution. Reasoning and control thus improve on separate timescales: the controller with more interaction data, the agent with more test-time search and a growing program library, and neither requires retraining the other. Physical execution grounds the agent’s reasoning, since it revises what it asks of the controller from observed outcomes rather than assumptions. We see this as a step toward humanoids that, like language models at inference time, improve by testing more, and accumulate skills as inspectable, reusable programs.
blocks.zh: InterEvolve为人形智能提出了不同的分工. 一个行为基础模型学习如何一次移动,任务知识生活在其分量之外,在语言模型可以通过执行来读取,编辑和测试的奖励程序中. 因此,理性和控制在不同的时间尺度上有所改进:交互数据较多的控制器,测试时间搜索较多的代理器和不断增长的程序库,两者都不需要再培训对方. 实体执行为代理人的推理提供了依据,因为它根据观察到的结果而不是假设修改了对控制者的要求。 我们认为这是向人造物迈出的一步, 就像推断时的语言模型, 通过更多的测试来改进, 并积累技能作为可检查的,可重复使用的程序。

blocks.en: A.1 Interaction features
blocks.zh: A.1 互动特征

blocks.en:
For the G1 with rubber hands, the 105-dimensional interaction encoding tells the controller where the object is and how close each body link is to its surface. It concatenates a 15-dimensional object state with a 90-dimensional link term: one 3-D displacement from each of 30 body links to the object surface. The object state holds position, a six-dimensional orientation, and linear and angular velocity. Horizontal position is relative to the robot root and height stays in world coordinates, while orientation and velocities use the heading frame. For each link, the displacement to the nearest sampled object-surface point is normalized and weighted by an exponential of its distance. These features encode proximity rather than contact force.
The Inspire model keeps the same object state and adds the 24 Inspire finger links (12 per hand) to the link geometry, 54 links in total.

对于有橡胶手的G1,105维交互编码会告诉控制器物体的位置,以及每个机体链接与其表面的距离. 它使一个有90维链接名词的15维物体状态:从30个身体链接到物体表面的每一个中,一个3-D相位. 物体状态保持位置,六维取向,并有线性和角速度. 水平位置相对于机器人根和高度停留在世界坐标上,而取向和速度则使用取向框. 对于每个环节,迁移到最近取样的物体地表点是正常的,并以其相距的指数加权。 这些特征编码接近而非接触力.
Inspire模型保持了相同的对象状态并增加了24个Inspire指向链接几何的链接(每只手有12个),共54个链接.

blocks.en: Bank features and live context. Program code reads bank features and live context from separate namespaces, so that a reward means the same thing over the bank as in the rollout that executes its latent. F holds bank features, each a tensor over all N N bank states, so one call to reward returns the stage rewards r ^ j , n , t \hat{r}_{j,n,t} of Eq. 1 for the whole bank at once. C holds live context: scalars read from the current frame, such as the object-target distance, and the unit direction C["v_dir"] from the object toward its target. The split is needed because a live measurement is not a property of the bank states. A current contact report, for instance, says nothing about contact forces in a bank that stores only geometry. W exposes the constants 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} , namely relative reward weights and thresholds or kernel widths, and expressions can read only this declared interface.

blocks.en: The skill library ℋ \mathcal{H} is a text document built from completed tasks. Each entry records the scene, the task text the agent saw, the verifier with the pass rate of each criterion, the measured success, and the selected program with its tuned constants. A closing section states the lessons: reward-design regularities shared across the stored programs. blocks.en: More objects. Table 14 runs the eight selected programs, searched on the large box, unchanged on the plastic box, the small box, and the suitcase, which the controller saw in pretraining but no program saw during search. Rerunning the protocol on the large box reproduces Table 13 exactly. Transfer depends on the family and the object: lifting onto a support keeps 70–92% success on all three boxes, and the suitcase keeps most of the carrying and obstacle success, whereas push to mark reaches at most 25% on the other boxes even with its height band shifted, and the small box is almost never pushed around the obstacle. Averaged over families, the unchanged programs reach 36–59% on the new boxes. Adapting each program to the new box, raises the averages to 79–89%, each adapted program confirmed once with the same protocol; kicking the plastic and small boxes and pushing the plastic box around the obstacle did not improve and keep the unchanged program.

blocks.en: D.4 Fixed-program baselines
blocks.zh: D.4 固定方案基线

blocks.en: Human and initial agent programs are each evaluated before and after CMA-ES with the same feature access, parameter bounds, and rollout budget per program. Because reward-tilted inference couples reward scale with β \beta (Sec. B.1 ), we hold β \beta fixed when comparing reward formulations.
blocks.zh: 人类和初始代理程序在CMA-ES前后各评估,每个程序都有相同的特性访问、参数界限和推出预算。 因为悬赏推断的夫妇用β\β(sec.B.1)奖励比例表,我们在比较悬赏配方时将β\β固定.

blocks.en: D.5 Search-design ablations
blocks.zh: D.5 搜索-设计擦伤

blocks.en: Table 3 removes one of the five search components below at a time. Every variant runs on the same task families, controller, and verifier, and is scored on the program its selection rule returns.
blocks.zh: 表3一次去除下面五个搜索组件中的一个. 每个变体运行在相同的任务家族,控制器和验证器上,并在程序上被评分其选择规则返回.

blocks.en: CMA-ES tuning. In the full system, the inner loop tunes the constants 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} of every valid proposal with CMA-ES before the proposal is compared with the current best program (Sec. C.4 ). Without it, each proposal runs with the initial constants the agent wrote. This isolates how much of the gain comes from calibrating a given structure.
blocks.zh: CMA-ES调音. 在全系统中,内环会调和每份与CMA-ES有效的提案的常数 \\ boldsymbol\theta}在提案与当前最佳程序(Sec. C. 4)进行比较之前. 没有它,每个提案都与代理商写的初始常数运行. 这隔离了通过校正某个特定结构获得多少收益.

blocks.en: Targeted edits. In the full system, the agent sees the current best program and its feedback and is instructed to repair it: to change the stage or term that caused the failing criterion, or to merge stages from programs that lead on different criteria (Sec. C.2 ). The full-rewrite variant keeps the same context, feedback, acceptance rule, and budget, but asks for new programs written from scratch each round. This isolates the value of editing a working program over regenerating it.
blocks.zh: 目标编辑. 在完整的系统中,代理看到当前最好的程序及其反馈,并被指示修复:改变导致失败标准的阶段或名词,或者从不同标准的程序中合并阶段(Sec. C.2. 完整重写变体保持了相同的上下文,反馈,接受规则,以及预算,但要求从头开始每回合写出新的程序. 这将编辑一个工作程序的价值隔离于再生成程序。

blocks.en: Multi-scenario evaluation. In the full system, every candidate is evaluated on a grid of multiple search scenarios that vary the object’s bearing and distance (Sec. C.3 ). The single-scenario variant evaluates each candidate on one scenario and spends the saved budget on more candidates. This isolates whether judging a candidate across varied starts helps select edits that generalize rather than edits that happen to work once.
blocks.zh: 多事评价. 在完整的系统中,每个候选者都通过一个网格来评价改变物体轴承和距离的多处搜索方案(Sec.C. 3)。 单一情景变体对每个候选人进行一个方案的评价,并将节省的预算用于更多的候选人。 这会隔离对不同开始候选人的判断是否有助于选择能够概括而非编辑一次偶然有效的编辑。

blocks.en: Scene context. In the full system, the prompt describes the scene, such as object placement, supports, and obstacles, next to the task text. The variant gives the agent only the task text. The controller still observes the full scene, so this ablation affects planning but leaves feedback control intact.
blocks.zh: 场景背景. 在完整的系统中,提示会描述场景,例如对象放置,支持,和障碍,旁边是任务文本. 变体只给予代理任务文本. 控制器仍然观察整个场景,因此这种衰减会影响规划,但留下反馈控制完好无损.

blocks.en: Multi-stage programs. In the full system, a program may split the task into up to three stages with their own rewards and completion conditions. The single-stage variant must express the whole task with one reward from the same feature vocabulary under the same budget. This isolates the value of temporal composition.
blocks.zh: 多阶段程序。 在完整的体系中,一个程序可能将任务分出最多三个阶段,并有自己的奖励和完成条件. 单阶段的变体必须用同一预算下同一特征词汇的一个奖励来表达整个任务. 这孤立了时间构成的价值.

blocks.en: D.6 Skill-library reuse
blocks.zh: D.6 技能图书馆再利用

blocks.en: Library experiments fix everything except the library content, including the controller, the bank, and the target-task budget. The source library is frozen before target search and excludes the target task instances, so target rollouts inform only within-task revision. Table 5 varies library content on composite tasks.
blocks.zh: 图书馆实验除图书馆内容外,所有内容都固定,包括控制器,银行,以及目标任务预算. 源库在目标搜索前被冻结并排除目标任务实例,因此目标推出只为任务内修订提供信息. 表5 综合任务的图书馆内容不同。

blocks.en: Composite tasks. Table 15 describes the three composite tasks of Table 5 . Each combines several contact modes that appear separately among the eight task families of Table 12 , in one episode and from one initial reset: carrying and placing on a support, lifting and lowering onto another object, and pushing followed by kicking. As in the other families, the verifier scores the outcome and its constraints independently of the agent-written reward, and success requires every criterion in the same rollout. None of the three tasks, and no program written for them, is in any source library.
blocks.zh: 综合任务。 表15说明了表5的三项综合任务。 每一个组合了表12八个任务组中分别出现的几种接触模式,在一个插曲中,从一个初始的重置中:携带并放入一个支持上,起起并放入另一个对象上,再推后踢出. 与其他家族一样,核查者对结果及其限制的评分独立于代理笔录的奖励,而成功则需要同一推出的每一个标准. 三个任务中没有一个,也没有为他们编写的程序,都出现在任何源代码库中.

blocks.en: Table 15: Composite tasks for library reuse. Distances are measured from the box’s starting position.
blocks.zh: 表15:图书馆再利用的综合任务。 从盒子的起始位置测量距离。

blocks.en: Whether programs or lessons carry over. Table 16 extends the carry, place, and kick task of Table 5 with more library variants, all scored on the same 64 test scenarios. Lessons are the library’s shared design notes without its programs summarized by human. Run as stored, without search, only the kicking program solves any scenario (6.3%), so the gain comes from search adapting stored programs rather than from copying one. After three search rounds, the full library reaches 60.9%, programs without lessons 48.4%, lessons without programs 21.9%, and neither 12.5%. Among program subsets, the three carrying programs reach 23.4% and every subset that contains the kicking program reaches 43.8–53.1%, all below the full library.
blocks.zh: 无论是程序还是课程都延续下来. 表16扩展了表5的载体,位置和踢出任务,增加了库式变体,都在同一64个测试方案上得分. 课程是图书馆共享设计说明, 以存储方式运行,不进行搜索,只有踢出程序解决了任何场景(6.3%),因此收益来自搜索调整存储程序,而不是复制一个. 经过三轮搜索后,完整的图书馆达到60.9%,没有课的节目48.4%,没有课的节目21.9%,12.5%。 在程序子集中,三个携带程序达到23.4%,每个包含脚踢程序的子集达到43.8–53.1%,都低于完整的库.

Every row is scored on the same 64 test scenarios, none of which any search used; SR is the percentage of scenarios solved, where a scenario is solved when one of three rollouts meets every criterion. Left: each stored program run as written, without search. Right: three search rounds from each source library; the shaded row is the full library of Table 5 .

blocks.en: D.7 Coverage of the pretraining references
blocks.zh: D.7. 组织事项 培训前参考资料的覆盖面

blocks.en: Figure 11: Evolved skills versus pretraining references. Each point is one motion: an OMOMO largebox training clip (pink) or one rollout of an evolved skill (colored, 16 per skill; circles mark skill centers). A motion is described by its body posture relative to the pelvis and heading, summarized over time, and embedded with UMAP.

blocks.en: Fig. 11 compares evolved behaviors with the data the FB model was pretrained on. Carrying at ground height and pushing stay inside the reference cloud, whereas lifting onto a table, carrying at chest height, kicking, tipping, and carrying, placing, then kicking form their own clusters, so the InterEvolve can produce motions that no training reference contains.
blocks.zh: 图11 将进化的行为与FB模型被预训的数据进行比较. 以地高行走并被推入参考云中,而起入表上,以胸高行走,踢出,倒出,并携带,放出,再踢出自己的星团,因此InterEvolve可以产生任何训练参考文献所没有的动作.

blocks.en: Motions. We compare 729 OMOMO largebox clips and the evolved 11 skills with 16 rollouts each, cut to the interaction window (from 0.5 s before the object first moves to 0.5 s after it last moves).
blocks.zh: 动议 我们比较了729个OMOMO大盒夹和进化后11个技能,每个技术有16个推出,切到交互窗口(从对象先动前的0.5 s到其后动后0.5 s).

blocks.en: Descriptor. Only the body is used, so object size and scene layout cannot separate the two sets. For each frame, the 29 link positions are taken relative to the pelvis and rotated into the robot’s own heading, so walking direction and turning do not count as different motions. Each coordinate is resampled to 128 steps and summarized by its first 16 DCT coefficients, a low-frequency description of how the posture changes over the window.
blocks.zh: 释相者. 只有正文才被使用,因此对象大小和场景布局无法将两套相分离. 对于每个相框,29个链接位置相对骨盆被取出并被旋转到机器人自己的行走方向上,因此行走方向和转动不算是不同的运动. 每个坐标被重印为128个步骤,并被其前16个DCT系数所概括,低频描述姿态在窗口上的变化.

blocks.en: Embedding. Features are standardized with the reference statistics, reduced by PCA fit on the references (32 components, 91% of variance), and embedded jointly with UMAP.
blocks.zh: 内入. 特征与参考统计数据相统一,经参考文献(32个组件,91%差异)中的PCA相适应而减少,并与UMAP共同嵌入.

blocks.en: Distance check. Independently of the 2D layout, we measure each rollout’s distance to its nearest reference clip in the PCA space and rank it against the distance of each reference clip to its nearest reference from a different recording. The median rollout ranks at the 76th percentile; lifting onto a table, carrying at chest height, and carrying, placing, then kicking rank at the 98th, and carrying at ground height and pushing around a pillar at the 18th and 9th.
blocks.zh: 距离检查 独立于2D布局,我们测量每个推出的相距及其最接近的PA空间的参考相距,并对照每个参考相距的相距,从不同的录音中将其排入最接近的相距. 第76个百分位的中位推开排位;抬起到一个桌子上,抬起胸高,再抬起,放起,再踢起第98个排位,再抬起地高,再推起一根柱子在第18和第9个排位.

blocks.en: D.8 Transfer and physical deployment
blocks.zh: D.8 移交和实际部署

blocks.en: Perception. We deploy on a Unitree G1 whose policy commands the same 29 joints as in simulation at 50 Hz. An RGB-D camera on the torso streams color and depth to an off-board GPU workstation, which runs perception, state estimation, and the policy. FastSAM ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) and CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) find the box in the image, and FoundationPose ( Wen et al., 2024 ) registers a mesh of the box on this mask and tracks its 6-D pose frame by frame, discarding poses that disagree with the measured depth. Each pose is time-stamped at capture and mapped into the robot frame with the joint angles and leg odometry of that moment. A filter fuses these poses with box fits from a LiDAR on the torso and with floor and contact constraints, and uses the camera only while the box is free, since the arms occlude it during manipulation. From the filtered pose, the controller computes the same object features it observes in simulation.
blocks.zh: 观想相. 我们部署在Unitree G1上,它的政策指挥着与模拟50赫兹相同的29个关节。 躯干流上RGB-D相机的颜色和深度为离机GPU工作站,该工作站运行感知,状态估计,以及策略. FastSAM (Zhao等,2023年)和CLIP (Radford等,2021年)在图像中找到盒子,而FoundationPose (Wen等,2024年)在这个口罩上注册了盒子的网格并用帧来跟踪其6-D的外观框架,丢弃的外观与所测量到的深度不同. 每个姿势在捕捉时被打上时间戳,并用那个时刻的关节角度和腿部偏振来映入机器人框. 滤波器引信这些相机上装有从躯干上装有LiDAR并装有地板和接触限制的相机,并且只在相机放行时才使用相机,因为武器在操纵时会吞噬相机。 从被过滤的姿势中,控制器计算出它在模拟中观察到的相同对象特征.

blocks.en: Execution. A program is evolved and verified in simulation, and the latent prompts it produces during a simulated rollout are replayed on the robot, one per control step, while the frozen controller closes the loop on proprioception and the estimated object pose. Execution starts once the object estimate is confident, and it pauses while the estimate is invalid.
blocks.zh: 处决 一个程序在模拟中被演化并被验证,它在模拟推出过程中产生的潜在提示被重放在机器人上,每个控制步骤一个,而被冻结的控制器关闭了自控的回路和估计对象的姿势. 一旦对象估计有自信,执行就会开始,并在估计无效时暂停执行.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: Program search is bounded by the motor repertoire, the reward-inference bank, and the available measurements. It cannot elicit behavior the controller never learned. Each search also costs GPU-hours of simulation and LLM latency, which rules out real-time replanning during physical execution. Letting accumulated experience also update the controller is a next step.
blocks.zh: 程序搜索以电动机回溯器,奖励参考库,以及可用的测量数据为界. 它不能引起控制器从未学到的行为。 每次搜索还花费了GPU-小时的模拟和LLM活性,这排除了在实际执行期间的实时再规划. 让积累的经验更新控制器也是下一步。
